chunks: It is inscribed upon him that whoever follows him, he will beguile him and lead him to the torment of the Hellfire.

key_terms.السَّعِيرِ: The Hellfire, a place of intense burning
key_terms.تَوَلَّاهُ: Whoever follows him / takes him as a guardian

ai.seo_question: What is inscribed upon the Devil regarding those who follow him?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as describing the Devil's inherent nature and his role as a clear misleader (mubtin) whose followers are destined for the blazing fire. It underscores the concept of divine decree regarding Satan's persistent guidance into error, serving as a warning for believers to distinguish between true guidance and the deceptive allure of the accursed one. This highlights the practical implication of choosing one's spiritual leader (wali) carefully, as following the Devil leads inevitably to the Hellfire.
